portfolio: Latent cognitive-state to language: L1 treats an EXTERNALLY PROVIDED structured meaning record as a proxy only, not an acquired cognitive state.

experimental_question: Can factorized parallel, non-next-token per-slot conditional utterance realization with selectively learned autoregressive repair generate meaning-fidelitous surface text with better quality-vs-cost than trained left-to-right conditional chunk models on held-out combinations?
source: Unique meaning tuples chosen by deterministic SHA256-sorted ranking. Disjoint TRAIN/SELECT/INDOMAIN from nonwithheld tuples. Entire actor 'eli' × object 'door' pair excluded from TRAIN/SELECT/INDOMAIN and 80 unique heldout examples sampled from exactly this withheld pair. All lexical parts occur in other FIT examples. No aligned source leakage; target slots are PUBLIC training annotation given equally to all models.
surface_rules: Public supervised aligned surface slots: lowercase subject/object/adverb, the, '.', clause tense/neg determines aux and finite/bare verb; present affirmative inflects third-person, past affirmative inflects past, other cases bare verb. Render nonempty slots joined by single spaces with final '.' directly. Annotation reveals slot boundaries to ALL learners and gives an engineered syntactic scaffold; do not claim learned grammar/discovery.

models.PARALLEL_FACTOR: 8 separately trained categorical slot models; each selects meaning-field subsets of size 0..3 via L1_SELECT NLL with small complexity penalty; Laplace 0.5 smoothed TRAIN conditional counts; all slot predictions condition on meaning only and can conceptually run in parallel.
models.AUTOREGRESSIVE_CHUNK: Same aligned TRAIN and model search budget, but candidate slot features also allow the preceding generated surface chunk; left-to-right dependent categorical chunk generation and teacher-forced FIT counts, selected on L1_SELECT likelihood with identical smoothing.
models.PARALLEL_SELECTIVE_REPAIR: Reuse fitted PARALLEL_FACTOR and AUTOREGRESSIVE_CHUNK models; initially emit 8 factor slots then left-to-right verify with trained AR head; if AR p(proposed)<threshold and p(best)>p(proposed) replace. Threshold in [0.05,0.15,0.30] fixed by L1_SELECT exact match only; include total BOTH fitted checkpoints and verification compute/serial depth.
models.PARALLEL_UNCONDITIONAL: Public TRAIN fitted slot-wise smoothed majority words without meaning; ablation.
models.FULL_MEANING_LOOKUP: Public TRAIN exact six-field meaning tuple to aligned surface tokens; unseen meaning tuple falls back to slot-wise majority; memorization control.
models.SOURCE_KNOWN_TEMPLATE_DIAGNOSTIC: Privileged generator template; measures task information upper bound ONLY, not eligible trained comparator.

training.model_capacity: All trained slot models search same max 3 input features per slot; AR has one additional input field (previous chunk), so not parameter-matched. Full training corpus 512 target strings plus aligned slot annotations shared equally.

quality: mean fraction of 8 correct semantic surface slots
heldout previously unseen actor-object pair versus in-domain
resource: total fit+feature-search CPU per model, including SELECT
operation proxies: categorical count lookups, candidate scoring and sequential dependency stages; do NOT mislabel lookup operations as FLOPs
energy unavailable on hosted runners: label NOT_MEASURED
validation: L1_TRAIN and L1_SELECT only for fitting/feature selection/repair threshold; 128 L1_INDOMAIN_DEV and 80 L1_NOVEL_COMPOSITION_DEV inspected once per frozen experiment
